description: Techstars portfolio companies (5,600+): search by keyword and filter by region, country, first program year, exited or unicorn status. Each company: name, one-line description, website, city, state, country, region, industry verticals, Techstars programs attended, first session year, accelerator/network flags, exit and $1B+ flags, Crunchbase link and logo; plus the number of matches. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Optional country, as Techstars writes it, e.g. United States, Germany, Turkey

q.description: Keyword matched against name, description, city, programs and industry (default all)

region.description: Optional region: Americas, Europe, Asia, Africa, Oceania
